# Squads

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Unlock | the Office Floor or 8 people |
| Size | up to 6 squads of 1 to 8 people |
| Cohesion | fills over 12 weeks that at least half the squad works its posting; anyone joining or leaving halves it |
| Cohesion bonus | up to +10% output for members working the squad's posting, in proportion to cohesion |
| Bench after a launch | 2 weeks, then back to default work and the squad goes to maintenance |
| Idle squad | an advisor speaks after 2 weeks on an idle posting |
